classification.difficultyReason: Read elements, intersection, union and complements directly from a supplied two-set Venn diagram.

spec.description: Overlapping sets X and Y inside the universal-set rectangle labelled ξ. Decorative blue numerical labels are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: X only={10,2}; X intersection Y={5,1}; Y only={9,7,3}; outside both={4,6,8}.
spec.answerVisibility: All numerical elements, set labels and boundaries are permanent givens; response answers are omitted.

answer.worked: Include every element inside $X$, including the overlap: $X=\{10,5,2,1\}$.
Include every element inside $Y$, including the overlap: $Y=\{9,5,1,7,3\}$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: List the elements of both set $X$ and set $Y$.

answer.worked: The elements in the overlap belong to both sets, so $X\cap Y=\{5,1\}$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: List the elements of set $X$ or set $Y$.

answer.worked: Include all elements in either circle, listing the overlap only once: $X\cup Y=\{10,5,2,1,9,7,3\}$.

answer.worked: Include the elements in the universal set outside circle $X$: $\overline{X}=\{4,6,8,9,7,3\}$.
